items.item_text: Applies advanced business analysis concepts to identify, evaluate and define highly complex systems scope and objectives based on advanced knowledge of applicable business practices, processes and systems and industry standards to meet end-user needs. Works at the highest technical level with SQL, PL/SQL, Java, Web Services (SOAP/RESTful), XML, Excel Templates, Workflow, SFTP, and work with SAAS based solution (CSGOLD, Illumia, CashNet, Canvas, StarRez, NuPark) to integrate them via API. Report on project status, issues, and resolves a wide range of technical problems.
Demonstrates competency in selecting tools, methods, and techniques to obtain results and technically astute with the ability to troubleshoot complex applications with multiple integrations.

Collaborate across Information Technology, campus, and the UC on projects taking on a multitude of roles from project lead, developer, analyst, tester. Communicate issues clearly and train/develop other team members. Work with Service Now, Jira, and other organizational tools. Support production, upgrades, changes, and user support requests via on-call rotation. Create and maintain functional BP080 and BR100, and technical MD050, MD070 documentation. Lead cross-functional teams to address complex business or systems issues. Initiate, facilitates, implements, and documents work process changes. Prepares and approves or obtains approval for business process and procedural documentation. Initiate and oversees changes in processes and procedures. Set the technical requirements for complex specifications.

Performs highly complex setups, configurations, analysis of business and user needs, documentation of requirements and translation into the proper system and process requirement specifications in the areas of Campus Card, Campus Access Management and Safety, CSGold, Food, Nutrition, Dining Services and Payments. Serve as a cross-module integration project coordinator to assist in the resolution of cross-module issues. Review and test new functionality, patches, and releases prior to deployment. Evaluate customized solutions and develop approaches collaboratively with business teams on how to best leverage delivered CsGold functionality, minimize customizations, and maximize benefits across the enterprise. Drive results and maximize value by staying current with Illumia product and service enhancements, roadmap, and platform upgrades.
